lead.headline: BUN SHIPS BUN-V1.3.14
lead.deck: Bun, a JavaScript runtime, has been updated to version 1.3.14
lead.body: The latest release of Bun includes contributions from 11 developers, addressing various improvements and bug fixes. This update is part of the ongoing effort to refine the performance and reliability of the platform. As a result, users can expect enhanced stability and efficiency when working with Bun. The release notes, available on the Bun blog, provide a detailed account of the changes and enhancements made in this version. The update is now available for installation, and users can take advantage of the improvements by upgrading to the latest version. This development is significant for the Bun community, as it continues to build on the platform's capabilities and user experience
